---
title: "Data manifest"
---

Every file this project depends on, with its size, its SHA-256 sum, where it
came from, who supplied it, and whether they have agreed to redistribution:
the third-party originals (stage `original`) and the reference data this
project converted from them (stage `converted`).

The manifest is generated by `scripts/build_manifest.py` from two things: the
files on disk, in `data/original/` and `data/converted/<collection>/`, and the
hand-written provenance in `gia_mip/resources/provenance.json`. The script
fails if the two disagree, so a file added without provenance is caught when
the manifest is rebuilt.

A converted file names the originals it was built from in `derived_from`, and
its permission follows theirs. It also has an `object` key,
`versions/<sha256>/<path>`: the name of the object on the store and of its
place in a cache. The key contains the sum, so every version of a converted
file stays on the store under its own name, and a release of gia-mip always
downloads the version it was built with.

```{python}
#| echo: false
import json, pathlib
from IPython.display import Markdown

manifest = json.loads(
    (pathlib.Path("../..") / "gia_mip" / "resources" / "manifest.json").read_text()
)

rows = ["| File | Collection | Stage | Size | Members | Permission |",
        "| --- | --- | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |"]
for rel, a in manifest["artifacts"].items():
    members = a.get("member_count", "")
    rows.append(
        f"| `{rel}` | {a['collection']} | {a['stage']} | {a['bytes'] / 1e6:.1f} MB | "
        f"{members} | {a['permission']} |"
    )
total = sum(a["bytes"] for a in manifest["artifacts"].values())
rows.append(f"| **{len(manifest['artifacts'])} artifacts** | | | "
            f"**{total / 1e6:.0f} MB** | | |")
Markdown("\n".join(rows))
```

`permission` is one of `granted`, `requested` or `not_asked`. A file whose
permission is not `granted` is never uploaded to the object store and is never
downloaded by `python -m gia_mip.data` or `gia_mip.data.locate`.

## Provenance

```{python}
#| echo: false
blocks = []
for rel, a in manifest["artifacts"].items():
    blocks.append(f"### `{rel}`\n")
    blocks.append(f"{a['description']}\n")
    if a.get("source_doi"):
        blocks.append(f"**Source** doi:[{a['source_doi']}](https://doi.org/{a['source_doi']}). "
                      f"{a['source_citation']}\n")
    else:
        blocks.append(f"**Source** {a['source_citation']}\n")
    blocks.append(f"**Supplied by** {a['supplier']}, received {a['received']}. "
                  f"Redistribution: {a['permission']}.\n")
    blocks.append(f"**SHA-256** `{a['sha256']}`\n")
    if a.get("derived_from"):
        blocks.append(f"**Derived from** {', '.join(f'`{d}`' for d in a['derived_from'])} "
                      f"by `{a['converter']}`. **Object** `{a['object']}`\n")
    if a.get("notes"):
        blocks.append(f"**Notes** {a['notes']}\n")
Markdown("\n".join(blocks))
```
